case.summary: Transaction 3562068 on card C13190-K2 was flagged as part of a coordinated fraud cluster involving eight cardholders and two shared device profiles. Between December 11, 2016, and January 3, 2017, this group generated 16 transactions totaling $3,949.84. Although the bank's risk score was low, the model probability of 0.6269 and the high similarity to prior confirmed fraud cases like CC-3667 support a fraud verdict. The card was blocked and a report filed per policy R2 and R6.

sar.narrative: Between December 11, 2016, and January 3, 2017, the bank identified a series of suspicious online transactions involving card C13190-K2 and seven other accounts. On December 21, 2016, transaction 3562068 for $199.93 was conducted using a MacOS device profile (Mac OS X 10_9_5, Chrome 66.0). This specific device profile was found to be shared by four other cardholders—C01519, C02222, C04367, and C06224—within a one-week period. Further analysis linked these accounts to a second device profile (iOS 10.0.2), forming a cluster of 16 transactions totaling $3,949.84. The cardholder C13190 has a prior history of confirmed fraud (CC-5518) involving unrecognized devices. The coordinated use of these two unusual device profiles across multiple unrelated cardholders indicates a sophisticated fraud ring. This activity mirrors patterns observed in previous confirmed fraud cases CC-3667 and CC-1356. The bank has blocked all involved cards and is filing this report due to the high probability of coordinated card-not-present fraud.

stop_reason: Actions were taken according to policy section 6, specifically R6 for shared origin and R2 for shared device profiles, to address the coordinated fraud risk.
